mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment rate (above 7.0%) signals a weak labor market and potential economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (below 600) and retail sales (below 340,000) indicate broad demand contraction, which typically precedes negative equity market performance over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 600 and RSAFS < 340000.

mechanism_narrative: A supply-constrained manufacturing environment (INDPRO below 105) reflects weak industrial output, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (above 11,700) signals robust economic expansion, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 11700.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL above 210) suggests the Federal Reserve will tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 210.

mechanism_narrative: Weak job growth (PAYEMS below 135,000) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE above 7.0%) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which typically results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 135000 and UNRATE > 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS above 0.5%) signals a shift to restrictive policy, which typically causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.
